feeds.title: Dr Sara Wickham
feeds.description: This website is the online home of midwife, teacher, author and researcher Dr Sara Wickham. It contains hundreds of free articles and blog posts for anyone seeking information about birth and midwifery as well as details of other resources, Sara's online courses, live events and books. Follow this site and get information, inspiration and illumination for midwives.

feeds.title: Midwife and Life
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jenny, I am a qualified Midwife, Blogger and a Mum of 3. I needed a flexible career that used my skills and knowledge but allowed me to work from home. Blogging and offering my services as a Midwife advisor allows me the freedom to do this. Follow this blog as I help you through pregnancy and parenting.

feeds.title: All4Maternity Blog
feeds.description: All4Maternity is an online platform to support, develop and nurture every midwife and maternity worker: from volunteers, doulas, aspiring midwives, obstetricians through to senior clinicians, academics, leaders and change agents working throughout maternity services.

feeds.title: The Midwives Of New Jersey Blog
feeds.description: Birth Stories & Announcements, Events, Lisa's Corner, and Midwifery News. Key topics covered are Motherhood, Health & Wellness, Pregnancy & Birth, Breastfeeding, Babycare, and Women's Health. 'The Midwives of New Jersey' is the premier provider of prenatal care in the state.

feeds.title: Stand and Deliver
feeds.description: I have longstanding personal and professional interest in childbirth, maternity care, breastfeeding, and women's issues. During my graduate studies, I attended both home and hospital births as a certified doula and as a midwife's assistant. My current research endeavors include vaginal breech birth, human rights in childbirth, physiologic birth, out-of-hospital birth, and midwifery. Follow this blog to get articles on midwives, childbirth and much more.

feeds.title: Think Birth
feeds.description: Exploring birth, science & midwifery. My background is midwifery and primary health care. I have had twenty five years experience as a private midwife providing continuity of care to women and their families.

feeds.title: A Midwife's Muse
feeds.description: Midwifery & childbirth, family. Married, for over 40 years, awaiting a long service medal. I am a Mum to 3 and also have several grandchildren, I have been privileged enough to be at all their births. I am now an ex-midwife. I retired in the first half of 2017.

feeds.title: The New York State Association of Licensed Midwives News
feeds.description: The Voice of Midwives in New York. We are a group of practicing Licensed Midwives from every part of the state of New York who has come together to meet the needs of midwives practicing in every type of practice setting.

feeds.title: Mumsy Midwife
feeds.description: Midwife - Mum - Parent - Pregnancy - Lifestyle - Beauty. A 20 something midwife, now a mum. I've worked in midwifery for years and now I'm taking the giant leap into motherhood. I blog about pregnancy, parenting and terrible TV along with any other musings that take my fancy, such as the art of eating good cake. Follow my blog as I share my views on midwives and pregnancy.

feeds.title: Metro Midwifery Blog
feeds.description: With over twenty years of combined experience, Gina and Nedra are dedicated to providing safe, compassionate, and skilled midwifery care to the Denver metro area.

feeds.title: Midwives Alliance of North America
feeds.description: In 1982, the Midwives Alliance of North America (MANA) was established as a professional organization for all midwives. MANA seeks to unify and strengthen the profession of midwifery, thereby improving the quality of health care for women, babies, and communities. Follow this blog to get all information on midwives, recognizing the diversity of educational backgrounds and practice styles within the profession.

feeds.title: Emunah Midwifery Blog
feeds.description: A blog by midwife El Tarver on topics related to pregnancy, birth, postpartum care, fertility, and the politics of midwifery in the U.S.

feeds.title: Pregnancy, Birth and Beyond
feeds.description: Our website is an up to date and extensive source of information on pregnancy, birth, parenting and breastfeeding. You'll be able to find lots of information on midwifery care, pre-conception care, pregnancy, birth, waterbirth, homebirth, vaginal birth after caesarean, postnatal care and breastfeeding. Pregnancy, Birth and Beyond provides private midwifery services, quality childbirth education.

feeds.title: Natural Pregnancy Midwife
feeds.description: Welcome to Natural Pregnancy Midwife.com. This site has grown out of my passion for natural pregnancy and birth. About me, well my experience with natural pregnancy and childbirth began way back when I was a small child. Natural Pregnancy Midwife Updates keeps you up-to-date with all additions and changes to the natural-pregnancy-midwife.com website.

feeds.title: Feminist Midwife Blog
feeds.description: Ponderings on women, health, and care. Welcome to Feminist Midwife! I'm a midwife working in urban America. Currently in my third year of practice, I'm constantly considering the roles of reproductive rights, women, and healthcare in the States and abroad. I hope to find in this blog a space to process, learn, and grow. I'm fired-up, emotional, excited, and thrilled about it all.

feeds.title: Musings of a Midwife
feeds.description: Musings of a Midwife

feeds.title: Midwife in Berlin
feeds.description: I am Katrin O'Malley an Irish/German midwife who believes in the womans right to choose her birthplace. Midwife in Berlin is a Blog to guide you through your pregnancy, birth and beyond. A must for everybody who is not familiar with the German Midwifery System.

feeds.title: Wonderfully Made!
feeds.description: The midwife caregivers at Promise Community Health Center in Sioux Center, Iowa, love caring for moms and their babies. They share Promise Baby announcements and advice for prenatal and newborn care in this informative blog, Wonderfully Made!

feeds.title: Joy of Life Family Medicine
feeds.description: Dr. Joy Frazer is a midwife and a naturopathic doctor who specializes in natural birth, lactation consulting, pediatrics, and homeopathy.

feeds.title: Thoughts of mine, and others.... Blog
feeds.description: I've been a practising midwife since 1978, totally committed to supporting midwives to maximise potential for all women to have a positive birth experience.

feeds.title: Urban Village Midwife
feeds.description: Building sustainable communities, perinatal health equity, and birth innovation that fuels human potential. Hakima Tafunzi Payne has a Bachelor's of Nursing and a Master's in Nursing Education. She is currently a student of Midwifery working toward the CPM credential. She is an Internationally Board Certified Lactation Consultant (IBCLC) and a Certified Nurse Educator (CNE).

feeds.title: Carolyn's blog
feeds.description: Midwifery, midwifery education, web 2.0. Welcome to this discussion about midwifery and midwifery education.

feeds.title: Generations Midwifery Clinic Blog
feeds.description: Midwives Serving Brockville, Kemptville, Smith Falls and Surrounding Area. Personalized, quality maternity and midwifery care for people in the Brockville, Kemptville, Smiths Falls and surrounding areas. Follow this blog to know everything about midwives and maternity.

feeds.title: Midwife Without Boundaries
feeds.description: Midwife without boundaries blog focuses on humanitarian aid, culture and personal stories from the life of author as she travels and attends the births in some of the most dangerous and remote places around the world.

feeds.title: Royal College of Midwives Blog
feeds.description: Midwifery Journals, Article Database. The globally respected information service for midwives - if you're a midwife or student on a midwifery course, MIDIRS can help. Follow this blog to keep up to date with current knowledge and thinking through continuing professional development as a midwife.

feeds.title: Midwife Business Blog
feeds.description: Our goals are to promote midwifery resilience, entrepreneurial spirit, and resources that communities can utilize to create a stronger midwifery future!

feeds.title: A Midwife on the Path
feeds.description: I am a Midwife working in a free standing birth center and striving to improve Maternal/Infant healthcare in the US. Follow this site to get more information on midwives.

feeds.title: Mother to Mother Midwifery
feeds.description: The latest updates from Mother to Mother Midwifery. It is a midwife-owned practice that provides for homebirth, waterbirth, prenatal, well-woman, and gynecological care.
